title: Present Tense: Regular Verbs
summary: Conjugate regular -ar, -er, and -ir verbs in the present tense.

sections.heading: Regular present endings: -AR, -ER, -IR
sections.body:
Remove the infinitive ending and add the present endings. This table shows one regular verb from each conjugation group.

| Subject | falar (-ar) | comer (-er) | abrir (-ir) |
|---|---|---|---|
| eu | **falo** | **como** | **abro** |
| você/ele/ela | **fala** | **come** | **abre** |
| nós | **falamos** | **comemos** | **abrimos** |
| vocês/eles/elas | **falam** | **comem** | **abrem** |

examples.pt: Nós abrimos a loja às nove.
examples.en: We open the store at nine.

sections.heading: Regular -ER verbs
sections.body: Regular **-er** verbs use endings like **comer**: como, come, comemos, comem.

sections.heading: Regular -IR verbs
sections.body: Regular **-ir** verbs are similar to -er verbs, but the nós form ends in **-imos**.

keyPoints: Regular verbs follow predictable endings by verb family.
Você uses the same form as ele/ela.
Vocês uses the same form as eles/elas.

commonMistakes.note: In the standard form, assistir = watch takes a.
